On top of the altar sits a central tabernacle or reliquary structure, flanked by two tall white candles in wooden holders. Behind the altar is a reredos featuring stained glass panels and floral arrangements. In the foreground, out-of-focus greenery and flowers partially obscure the base.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The gold embroidered patterns on the red cloth appear slightly soft and lack the crisp thread definition expected in high-resolution photography, suggesting minor generative smoothing or texture blending.

The junction where the central red-and-white tabernacle meets the altar top is slightly ambiguous. The base seems to merge softly with the white cloth underneath rather than sitting sharply on it, indicating minor edge bleeding.
The bases of the candle holders appear slightly uneven in their contact with the altar surface, with subtle warping in the elliptical perspective of the bases.
